topic.title: Returning an Array from a Method

sections.title: 🎯 What You'll Learn
sections.content:
Let's explore how methods can return arrays—just like a vending machine gives you a whole pack of snacks instead of just one!

• How to declare methods that return arrays
• The syntax for returning array values
• Practical examples where this is useful

sections.title: 💡 Concept Explanation
sections.content:
Imagine you're at a bakery. You ask for 'a dozen cookies,' and the baker hands you a whole tray (an array!) of cookies—not just one. Methods can do the same with arrays!

When a method returns an array, it's like getting a whole collection of values packaged together. Here's how it works:

• The method's return type is the array type (e.g., `int[]`)
• You create and fill an array inside the method
• Use `return` with the array name

Example: A method that returns the first 5 even numbers would look like this:

sections.content: Step-by-step visualization of how Returning an Array from a Method works:

steps.title: Method Declaration
steps.description: The method is declared with an array return type (e.g., `int[]`).

steps.title: Array Creation
steps.description: Inside the method, an array is created and filled with values.

steps.title: Return the Array
steps.description: The array is returned to the caller, who can now use it.

sections.title: ⚡ Key Points
points: ✓ Return type must match the array type (e.g., `int[]` for integers)
✓ The array is created inside the method, not outside
✓ Use `return arrayName;` to send the array back
✓ The caller gets the whole array, not just one value
✓ Arrays are passed by reference (changes affect the original)

sections.title: 🔥 Tips & Mistakes
dos: Initialize the array inside the method
Return the array directly (no need for extra steps)
donts: Don’t forget the `[]` in the return type
Don’t return a single element instead of the array
Don’t modify the array after returning it (unless intended)
sections.protip: Use this when you need to return multiple values of the same type—like a list of scores or names!

sections.title: 🌍 Real World Use
sections.content: Where is Returning an Array from a Method used in real apps?

examples.how: A method returns an array of daily temperatures for the week.
A method returns an array of high scores from a leaderboard.

problem.description: Write a method `generateMultiples` that returns an array of the first 10 multiples of a given number (e.g., for 3, return `[3, 6, 9, ..., 30]`).
hints: Create an array of size 10 first
Use a loop to fill the array with multiples
Return the array at the end
problem.explanation: The method creates an array, fills it with multiples using a loop, and returns the array. The caller can then use these values!

sections.title: 📝 Summary
points: 📌 Methods can return arrays just like they return single values
📌 Practice by returning lists of numbers, names, or other data
📌 Ready to learn about passing arrays to methods next!
